scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run pywrangler dev --port 8787
scripts.deploy:api: cd backend && uv run pywrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:frontend: npm --workspace frontend run build && cd frontend && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name namo-jan-connect
scripts.deploy:vercel: npm --workspace frontend run build && cd frontend && npx vercel --prod
